_comment: Release 7 (2026-11-17): snapshot R10.48b-scroll-speed-crashfix-2026-11-17 (the build in daily use on the TV) = release 6 (R10.37) + the next-episode card, quality tiers, Remove From Row and Save To Watchlists picker, stability bundle, friend-install hint-row removal, hand-off timing, TMDb Helper rows paused while browsing, scroll speed and its crash fix. The 7 extras/next-episode/*.png images are untracked assets from staged/R10.36-next-episode-card. Skin 3.99.418.7 and POV 6.99.1103.6 re-derived with tools/derive_inputs.py; netflix_profiles.py stays the public redacted file. Setup 1.0.6 = R10.44 release-only default.py + the R10.48b NetflixMovieDetails.xml and NetflixWatchlistMore.xml key files. Release 6 (2026-11-16): snapshot R10.37-startup-splash-owner-2026-11-16 = release 5 (R10.33) + the 6 R10.37 start-up splash files (skin only). btn_revision 6 is for the private assembly of the skin only: POV is not re-derived and stays 6.99.1103.5 in config/release.lock.json (its sources are byte-identical to release 5). Setup 1.0.5 (R10.38 home-row recipe) is built from src/ by tools/build_release.py; this file's Setup entry only labels the private assembly. Release 5 (2026-11-15): snapshot R10.33-stabilise-bundle-2026-11-15 = release 4 + R10.28 POV call counter, R10.29 Back twice to Video add-ons, and the R10.33 bundle (R10.29.1 Back-twice return, R10.31 show page after Stop, R10.32 All Genres Trending). Not in it: R10.26 (not installed), R10.27 (no files), R10.30 (review fixes pending). Setup 1.0.4 ships R10.29's NetflixRootBack.xml. Release 4 (2026-11-15): snapshot R10.22-lists-and-episodes-2026-11-15 = release 3 + R10.23 post-stop park, R10.24 grid speed-up, R10.25 security fixes, R10.22 My Lists and episodes. Release 3: snapshot R10.21.1-no-forced-start-2026-11-14 = release 2 (R10.13) + R10.17 UI polish, R10.18 Favorite/Watchlist toggles, R10.19 option C picker and genre menu, R10.21 grid-freeze fix, R10.21.1 no-forced-start. Not in it: R10.20 (rolled back), R10.23+ and the staged R10.25 security fixes / repository 2.1 patches. Overlays = every shipped set in install order (rolled-back R10.9, R10.9.1, R10.10.1, R10.11b, R10.20 left out; R10.12 MUST stay: its 10 loading images exist only there). MAC1-laptop-layout is NOT in this release (TV-only). Release 4: Setup 1.0.3 (fifth key file NetflixWatchlistMore.xml), repository 1.0.1 (SHA-256). Since release 2.1 this file drives only the PRIVATE assembly; tools/build_release.py builds the published zips from config/release.lock.json. Edit repo_slug (and github_user) to rename the GitHub repo; everything else follows. Then run tools/build_repo.py.
